meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Azure CLI 查询你 Azure 订阅里各类资源的配额上限、当前用量和剩余可用量,并可按需提交配额提升申请。它会按资源提供方和区域列出配额表,也支持跨区域对比可用容量。
howto.when: 当你要规划部署、校验容量或挑选 Azure 区域,或提到「查配额」「服务限制」「配额已超」等关键词时触发。

say.text: 对比 eastus 和 westus2 的 vCPU 配额,哪个更适合部署?
say.note: 逐个区域取限值与用量并算出可用量

say.text: 把 eastus 的 standardDSv3Family 配额提升到 500
say.note: 提交提升申请,多数可调整配额会自动批准

howto.what_en: After install, Claude uses Azure CLI to check your Azure subscription quotas: limits, current usage and available capacity per provider and region, and can submit quota increase requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you plan a deployment, validate capacity, pick a region, or mention "check quotas", "service limits", "quota exceeded" and similar terms.

say_en.text: Check quotas and available capacity for Microsoft.Compute in eastus
say_en.note: Returns a table of limits, usage and available capacity

say_en.text: Compare vCPU quota in eastus vs westus2 - which fits my deployment?
say_en.note: Reads limit and usage per region, computes available

say_en.text: Raise the standardDSv3Family quota in eastus to 500
say_en.note: Submits the increase request; adjustable quotas auto-approve
